Start date: 1184-06-30  
Add 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 4 days → total added = 340 days.  

1184 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception in the Gregorian rule for 1184).  
Days from June 30 to end of 1184:  
June: 1 day left (June 30 → June 30 inclusive? No, adding days moves forward from June 30).  
Actually: From June 30, adding 340 days:  

June 30 + 1 day = July 1.  
So days in 1184 after June 30:  
July (31) + Aug (31) + Sep (30) + Oct (31) + Nov (30) + Dec (31) = 184 days left in 1184 after June 30.  

340 − 184 = 156 days into 1185.  

1185 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31 = 151 days (Jan 1 to May 31 = 151 days).  
156 − 151 = 5 days into June → June 5, 1185.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1185-06-05
